expo.name: speac
expo.description: speac — a 2-minute daily speaking prompt. Record, get coached on fillers, pace, and word choice, and get sharper before the interview, the meeting, or the camera.

infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: speac needs the microphone so you can practice speaking and get coached.
infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: speac transcribes your practice so we can coach fillers, pace, and clarity.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: speac does not browse your photos. A built-in file component may check photo permission when handling files on this iPhone.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: speac does not save to Photos. This is required by a built-in file component on iOS.
infoPlist.NSMotionUsageDescription: Device motion may be used for on-screen animation. speac does not collect or send motion data.

plugins.microphonePermission: speac needs the microphone so you can practice speaking and get coached.
